testimonials.name: Ramesh Reddy
testimonials.text: Delivery reached my village in 3 days and the product details were clear. Crop-wise search saved me a trip to the town shop.

testimonials.name: Lakshmi Devi
testimonials.text: Easy to compare pack sizes and prices. The safety tips on the page helped me spray the right way.

testimonials.name: Mahesh Patil
testimonials.text: Genuine brands and proper invoices. Support answered on WhatsApp the same day when I had a question about dosage.

testimonials.name: Suresh Naik
testimonials.text: Ordered before the season started and it arrived on time. Prices were lower than the local dealer.

testimonials.name: Anitha Kumari
testimonials.text: The season calendar reminded me when to sow and when to protect the crop. Very useful for a first-time online buyer.

testimonials.name: Venkat Rao
testimonials.text: I like that bio-products are easy to find. The product page explained where and when to use neem oil.

testimonials.name: Prakash Gowda
testimonials.text: Bulk fertilizer bags were delivered to the farm gate. Paid by UPI and got the GST bill on my phone.

testimonials.name: Kavitha S.
testimonials.text: The sprayer works well and came with clear instructions. Return policy was explained before I paid.

testimonials.name: Ganesh Jadhav
testimonials.text: Good quality micronutrients and quick delivery. I now reorder every season from my order history.

pests.name: Stem borer
pests.symptoms: Dead hearts in young plants, white ears at flowering.

pests.name: Whitefly
pests.symptoms: Yellowing, sticky honeydew, leaf curl virus spread.

pests.name: Bollworm
pests.symptoms: Bore holes in bolls/fruits, frass, damaged squares.

pests.name: Blast
pests.symptoms: Spindle-shaped grey spots with brown margins on leaves.

pests.name: Broadleaf & grass weeds
pests.symptoms: Competition for light, water and nutrients.

pests.name: Nutrient deficiency / weak growth
pests.symptoms: Yellowing, stunting, poor flowering and fruit set.
